about: The reference Replace All (ADR-0332 §2 and §3): what is replaced, written or refused, all or nothing and uncapped, under the version it was read in, over rows written as the entries their cells' editors open with. A write to a column the file names in numberColumns takes only a number, and otherwise refuses with "not a number". From tests/ExGrid.Tests/GridReplaceTests.cs.
